daily.today_energy: The universe is giving you permission to be a little selfish today, Libra. Your energy is magnetic but needs grounding—think of it like charging your phone before the big night out. Balance isn't about perfection; it's about knowing when to pour and when to pause.
daily.love: Someone's been noticing the quiet confidence you're radiating lately. Whether single or coupled up, today's about authentic connection over surface vibes. If you've been holding back a truth, the cosmos is nudging you to speak it gently but clearly.
daily.career: Your creative problem-solving is *chef's kiss* right now. That project or conversation you've been nervous about? The energy supports you stepping into your expertise without second-guessing. Trust the preparation you've already done—you're more ready than you think.
daily.health: Your nervous system is asking for something slow today. Whether that's a long shower, a walk without your phone, or just sitting with your thoughts—honor that quiet call. Movement feels good, but so does rest. Pick whatever your body's genuinely craving.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about recalibrating your vibe. Mercury's got you thinking deeply about what you actually want versus what you think you should want. Trust the quiet knowing.
weekly.love: Someone's energy is shifting around you and it's giving clarity. Whether you're coupled up or solo, this is about getting real with yourself about what genuine connection looks like for you.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. Don't sleep on that thing you've been thinking about—the universe is basically saying it's your time to speak up and be seen doing your thing.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for slower, more intentional movement. Think less hustle, more alignment. Listen to what feels good instead of what sounds productive. Your nervous system will thank you.
